title: Illustrative exercise-generation study
summary: A synthetic release showing how exgen-bench reports end-to-end yield, uncertainty, failure accounting, paired case evidence, and provenance. Orchard and Quartz are invented systems; every observation on this page is illustrative.
notice: Not benchmark results. Do not cite, compare, or reuse these synthetic estimates as empirical findings.

scope.budget: 2 repetitions per brief and system; illustrative fixed budget

primary_contrast.note: With six synthetic briefs, this interval is deliberately wide. It is a demonstration of cluster-aware reporting, not evidence that either invented system is better.

cases.title: Bounded counter
cases.brief: Create a small counter abstraction with explicit lower and upper bounds, plus tests for boundary behavior.
cases.evidence_status: Synthetic summary only; no generated source artifacts are published for the demo.

cases.title: Library catalog
cases.brief: Design a catalog that stores books by identifier and supports deterministic search and removal behavior.
cases.evidence_status: Synthetic summary only; no generated source artifacts are published for the demo.

cases.title: Temperature series
cases.brief: Implement a time-ordered temperature series with summary statistics and clear empty-series semantics.
cases.evidence_status: Synthetic summary only; no generated source artifacts are published for the demo.

cases.title: Route planner
cases.brief: Generate a graph-based route planner that chooses a shortest valid route and reports unreachable destinations.
cases.evidence_status: Synthetic summary only; no generated source artifacts are published for the demo.

cases.title: Reservation ledger
cases.brief: Create a reservation ledger with conflict detection, cancellation, and a stable chronological view.
cases.evidence_status: Synthetic summary only; no generated source artifacts are published for the demo.

cases.title: Discount policy
cases.brief: Model composable discount rules with eligibility constraints and deterministic rounding.
cases.evidence_status: Synthetic summary only; one illustrative infrastructure failure has no candidate evidence.

metrics.name: Independent strict acceptance
metrics.construct: End-to-end probability that one planned generation yields a complete exercise accepted by the independent evaluator within budget.
metrics.population: All planned attempts in the frozen design
metrics.denominator: Planned attempts; started-attempt sensitivity reported alongside it
metrics.status_mapping: accepted=1; quality_failed, abstained, generation failure, cancellation, timeout, infrastructure failure, or not started=0
metrics.evidence: Typed gate outcomes and normalized candidate bundle

validation.method: Demonstration only; no instrument validation was performed

metrics.limitations: Synthetic observations, six briefs, and wide uncertainty; not an empirical system comparison

metrics.name: Artifact completeness
metrics.construct: Whether all required candidate roles were captured for independent inspection.
metrics.limitations: Completeness does not imply correctness or educational quality

metrics.name: Generation wall time
metrics.construct: Elapsed generation time observed by the coordinator.
metrics.direction: lower is better, conditional on outcome
metrics.status_mapping: timeouts retained as censored failures, never silently removed

validation.method: No validation evidence is included in this illustrative release

metrics.limitations: Provider load and execution order can confound latency

metrics.name: Semantic mutant rejection
metrics.construct: Ability of grading tests to reject specification-derived misconception implementations.
metrics.population: Strictly accepted candidates with applicable curated mutants
metrics.denominator: Applicable semantic mutants, reported alongside candidate count
metrics.status_mapping: not applicable and tool failure remain distinct from zero

validation.method: Requires expert review of mutant relevance

metrics.limitations: Measures one test-suite property, not overall exercise quality

limitations: All names, briefs, outcomes, estimates, and intervals in this release are synthetic.
Six briefs are too few for stable system-level inference; case-level variation remains visible.
Strict acceptance and conditional quality answer different questions and are never averaged together.
The demo contains no generated student-facing code and is not suitable for model or system claims.

provenance.designation_evidence: Built-in synthetic fixture; explicitly excluded from scientific result claims.
provenance.reproduction: Serve site/ statically; no computation is performed in the browser
